text:
Claire Patel: FYI — ACME (org: org_8Yh3) opened a ticket, says they suddenly can’t view audit logs. Root request returns 403 with an 'entitlement_missing' error. Customer is an org admin in their IdP. Can someone triage?

Claire Patel: Repro steps customer sent:
1) Login via SSO as admin@example.com
2) Hit API: `GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs?limit=100`
3) Response: 403

Claire Patel: Error body they pasted:```json
{"error":"entitlement_missing","message":"audit_logs:read entitlement required","code":"forbidden.audit_logs"}
```

Samir Rao: Putting this on eng-sre radar. Quick Q: is this for hosted customer or Dedicated?

Claire Patel: Hosted (prod region us-west2). They said audit logs were visible until last Thursday. No infra changes on their side.

Samir Rao: Thanks. Can you confirm the exact user email that failed and the org_id? Also, did they recently change SAML attribute mappings? Common cause: IdP stopped sending the 'roles' attribute that we map to the audit_logs entitlement.

Claire Patel: Email: admin@acme.example; org: org_8Yh3 (same as above). They say no deliberate mapping changes.

ops-bot: Entitlement-sync job for org_8Yh3 reported 1 failed update in last 24h — check logs: https://ops.redwood/internal/ent-sync/entries?org=org_8Yh3

audit-bot: Detected missing entitlement flag (audit_logs:read) for 2 users in org_8Yh3 at 2024-11-27T14:03:12Z. See internal incident ref: INC-2024-7745.

Liam O'Connor: Likely SAML role attr drop. Claire — can you ask customer to paste a SAML assertion extract (sanitized) or at least confirm the role/claim name they're sending? We map claims -> entitlement: e.g., `roles: ["admin","compliance"]` -> audit_logs:read.

Claire Patel: Customer provided a SAML assertion snippet. They only send `groups` now, not `roles`. Snippet (sanitized):```xml
<Attribute Name=\"groups\">
  <AttributeValue>acme-admins</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```
No roles attribute.

Julia Nguyen: If IdP sends only groups, we can map groups->entitlement but that mapping is managed via org-level entitlement mapping UI. Check Settings -> Security -> SSO Role Mappings for org_8Yh3. If nothing is mapped to audit_logs:read then users with only groups won't get access.

Claire Patel: I checked the console for org_8Yh3: Security -> SSO Role Mappings shows only `roles` mapping entries, nothing for `groups`. So mapping is empty for groups.

Samir Rao: There are two remediation paths: 1) Update IdP to include the `roles` attribute again (best long term). 2) Add a temporary groups->entitlement mapping in console or via API so acme-admins -> audit_logs:read. Do we want to apply mapping on their behalf? Customer asked for a quick fix.

Claire Patel: They asked us to enable access asap. I'll get their written consent to update mapping.

Priya Mehta (Billing): Quick note — audit log retention change requests sometimes require a compliance add-on entitlement (billing event). Are they also asking about retention? The customer mentioned they can only see 30 days of logs but expect 365.

Claire Patel: Yes — they reported both: missing access and retention only 30d. They believe they had 365d previously.

Liam O'Connor: Retention is separate. Retention >90d is a paid add-on in our product. If they were previously at 365d, they must have had the add-on and maybe the entitlement got removed during a billing sync issue. Claire — can you confirm their billing plan?

Claire Patel: Acme billing plan: org_8Yh3 currently on "Standard" with add-ons list empty in UI. Billing history shows a charge for "compliance-365-retention" on 2024-09-01 (invoice inv_2267). Strange.

Priya Mehta (Billing): Hmm — billing record exists. Could be a sync mismatch between billing ledger and entitlement service. I'll open an internal billing sync ticket and cc you, Claire. In parallel, we can re-provision the retention entitlement for the org if they consent — but this will create a retroactive invoice adjustment. Advise the customer.

Samir Rao: Meanwhile I'll patch the SSO mapping for groups for a quick fix. Please get written consent from customer since we're making config changes. I can apply mapping via internal admin tool and trigger an entitlement-sync. Steps I'll run (internal):
```bash
# pseudo-ops steps
POST https://internal-api.redwood/admin/orgs/org_8Yh3/ssomappings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "match_attribute": "groups",
  "match_value": "acme-admins",
  "entitlement": "audit_logs:read"
}
# then trigger entitlement sync
POST https://internal-api.redwood/internal/ent-sync/trigger?org=org_8Yh3
```

Claire Patel: Customer gave written ok: "We authorize Redwood to map group acme-admins to audit_logs:read and to re-provision retention while you investigate billing."

Samir Rao: Done — applied mapping and triggered sync. audit-bot shows entitlement assigned to 3 users in org_8Yh3 at 2024-11-27T15:22:09Z.

audit-bot: Entitlement assignment succeeded: audit_logs:read -> principal group acme-admins for org_8Yh3.

Claire Patel: Customer retried and reports now they can see logs, 200 on the API call. Verified via curl:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs?limit=10"
# returns 200 and recent events
```

Claire Patel: On retention — I re-provisioned their retention entitlement to 365d while billing investigates. Customer can now see older logs back to 2023-12-01. I informed them about possible retro billing adjustments.

Priya Mehta (Billing): I've opened billing ticket BILL-SYNC-1034 and linked inv_2267. I'll coordinate any invoice adjustments with finance and notify Claire when resolved.

Liam O'Connor: Postmortem actions: 1) Add an onboarding check to verify IdP sends either roles or groups mapping for audit entitlement; 2) Add an alert if billing shows an add-on charge but entitlement service shows no corresponding entitlement; 3) Make group->entitlement mappings visible via API for faster triage.

Julia Nguyen: I'll open a support playbook PR to add steps to triage this (SSO attr check, entitlement-sync command, quick mapping admin steps, and escalation path to billing).

Samir Rao: Also adding a small automated integration test to run after entitlement-sync jobs that verifies at least one admin principal in the org has audit_logs:read when billing ledger indicates retention add-on.

Claire Patel: Customer is happy and confirmed access restored. They've accepted potential retro billing. I'll leave the billing ticket open and will follow up. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

Liam O'Connor: Great. Claire — once billing confirms, please update INC-2024-7745 and close this support ticket.

Claire Patel: Will do. Closing for now since access restored. Will reopen if billing/retention diverges again.

Samir Rao: Closing notes saved to internal ops playbook. Good catch, team.
